objects.name: About
objects.value:
This is a small to-do stack. It is the first stack that HyperGeist can play.

On the To-do card, type a task into the field and press Add. The task appears in the list below the field.

Everything here is data: buttons, a field, a list and links. Switch to Edit mode to select an object and read its properties.

objects.name: Limits
objects.value:
Stacks are stored in this browser only. Clearing the browser's site data deletes them. Export a stack to keep a copy.

Changes save about a second after you stop. The "Saved" label shows when it is safe to close the tab. Closing the tab right after a change can lose the last second, because a browser may end the page before the write finishes.

If two tabs have the same stack open, they overwrite each other. The last save wins.

The open card and the mode are not saved. A reload returns to the start card in Interact mode.

Demo answers from the Ghost come from a shared model or from recorded examples. An own key is kept only in memory and is gone when you reload. The AI can be wrong. Every AI change can be undone with Undo.

AI fields use the shared demo model or an example answer. They can be wrong, so check what they write. One run counts against the demo limit.

Reminders fire only while HyperGeist is open or installed. A missed reminder is shown when you return. If notifications are blocked, a reminder shows inside HyperGeist only.

Adding with an empty field appends an empty item, because the stack format has no conditions.
